messages.マッチに勝つたびに呼吸回数が増え、コイン威力が伸びていく安定型の斬撃アタッカー。: A steady Slash attacker who gains Poise Count from Clash Wins and builds up Coin Power. Longer battles let him accumulate Poise and land repeated Critical Hits.
messages.バトルパッシブ「冷静」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): マッチ勝利時に呼吸回: **Combat passive — Poised (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains +1 Poise Count on Clash Win. Gains +1 Coin Power for every 5 Poise Count, up to +3. His Pride S1, Striker’s Stance, helps him meet the requirement himself. The Coin Power bonus requires Uptie Ⅳ.
messages.呼吸の獲得: S1は使用時に呼吸回数2、Ⅰコインで次のターンに呼吸を得る。S3「: **Gaining Poise**: S1 gains 2 Poise Count on use, and its Coin Ⅰ grants Poise next turn. S3, Flank Thrust, gains 2 Poise on use. S2, Heel Turn, increases Poise Count next turn on Clash Win.
messages.クリティカルの火力: S3のⅢコインはクリティカル発動時にダメージ量+50%/7: **Critical damage**: On a Critical Hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 deals +50%/70% damage, depending on Uptie tier, while his Counter defense skill deals +70% damage.
messages.サポートパッシブ「師事」(傲慢×3・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 精神力が最も高い味: **Support passive — Bestow (3 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: The 1 ally with the highest SP gains +1 additional Poise Count from skill effects.
messages.序盤はS1で呼吸を貯めつつ、基本威力が高く最低値の高いS2・S3で確実にマッチを: Early on, build Poise with S1 and use S2 and S3, whose higher Base Power gives them higher minimum rolls, to secure Clash Wins. Each win activates Poised and adds Poise Count, replenishing the 1 Count lost after a Critical Hit or at Turn End. In a long battle, he can reach 15 Poise Count for +3 Coin Power. Once Poise is established, aim for heavy Critical damage with Coin Ⅲ of S3 or Counter.
messages.耐久力が低いので反撃は耐性で受けられる場面に限るのが無難で、呼吸を配る剣契頭目の: His low durability makes Counter safest when his resistances let him take the incoming hit. A Blade Lineage team with Blade Lineage Mentor Meursault, who supplies Poise, greatly improves his performance.
messages.剣契頭目(ムルソー): 自分のスキル・コイン効果で呼吸を得るたびに、呼吸が最も少: **[Blade Lineage Mentor](persona:0508) (Meursault)**: His Swordplay of the Homeland passive (3 Pride Resonance, Uptie Ⅱ) gives +1 Poise Potency and Count to the 2 Blade Lineage Identities with the least Poise whenever he gains Poise Potency or Count through his own skill or Coin effects. This helps Blade Lineage Salsu build Poise faster.
messages.剣契殺手(ウーティス): 同じ剣契所属の人格。剣契頭目の戦闘開始時の「本国剣術」: **[Blade Lineage Salsu](persona:1102) (Outis)**: Another Blade Lineage Identity who can receive Swordplay of the Homeland from Blade Lineage Mentor at Combat Start. With at least 6 Blade Lineage members participating, the additional Poise becomes 2.
